speaker: Doctor
text: The significantly low sodium level of 122 mEq/L explains the confusion and lethargy. I need to determine if this is due to fluid overload or depletion, so REQUEST TEST: Serum Osmolality, TSH, and Free T4.

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal TSH and Free T4 rule out hypothyroidism as the cause of her hyponatremia. Given her severe hyponatremia (Na 122), lethargy, and lack of volume depletion or overload signs, SIADH is the leading diagnosis. I will request brain imaging to rule out a central cause like a tumor or stroke, which is critical given her smoking history. REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Brain.
